records.name: 塱原自然生態中心洗手間
records.address: 塱原自然生態中心地下
records.openingHours: 星期一、星期三至星期日及公眾假期上午9時30分至下午5時；星期二（公眾假期除外）及農曆年初一、初二休館。
records.openingHoursEn: 9:30 am–5:00 pm on Mondays, Wednesdays–Sundays and public holidays; closed on Tuesdays (except public holidays) and Lunar New Year days 1–2.
records.source: 漁護署塱原自然生態中心訪客設施
records.remarks: 漁護署官方設施頁列明訪客中心設有洗手間；本點按地政總署地名資料中明確命名的「Toilet (Long Valley Nature Centre)」座標轉換，並非由園區中心估算。
records.remarksEn: AFCD lists toilets among the visitor-centre facilities. This point is transformed from the Lands Department location-search entry explicitly named “Toilet (Long Valley Nature Centre)”; it is not estimated from the park centre.
